article.headline: Grand Canyon defeats Southern Utah 82-71
article.description: — Tyon Grant-Foster's 23 points helped Grand Canyon defeat Southern Utah 82-71 on Saturday night.
article.story: PHOENIX -- — Tyon Grant-Foster's 23 points helped Grand Canyon defeat Southern Utah 82-71 on Saturday night. Grant-Foster also contributed nine rebounds and three steals for the Antelopes (11-4, 1-0 Western Athletic Conference). Collin Moore scored 17 points, shooting 7 for 13, including 2 for 4 from beyond the arc. Duke Brennan shot 5 of 10 from the field and 6 for 7 from the free-throw line to finish with 16 points, while adding 15 rebounds. Dominique Ford led the Thunderbirds (8-7, 0-1) in scoring, finishing with 22 points and six rebounds. Jamir Simpson added 13 points for Southern Utah. Tavi Jackson had 12 points, nine assists and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
